subject: List of models tested don't include IID

messages.author: 3acab99816f5aedc
messages.subject: List of models tested don't include IID
parts:
Hi,
 In the paper "ctmm: an R package for analyzing animal relocation data as a continuous-time stochastic process" it gives an example of the fitting of various models (page 6, top left). After running fitted.mods<-ctmm.select , summary(fitted.mods) shows a list of 6 models: OUF anisotropic, OUF isotropic, OU anisotropic , OU isotropic, IID anisotropic, and IID isotropic. When I run ctmm.select  and view the results I only see the first 4, not the 2 IID models. Is there some setting that makes ctmm test IID also?

Thanks, Vilis

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: List of models tested don't include IID
parts:
Hi Vilis,

Behavior has a changed a little bit since then because the number of models keep expanding. As OUF,OU,IID are nested models, if OUF is selected over OU, then IID is not considered. You can add it to the list manually, though.

Best,
Chris
